name: 🚒 Firefighters!
desc:
Where are the heroes in real life? Here they are!
Become a Firefighter, risk your Life, be a Hero!
Go to buildings that are about to fall, extinguish the fire, and save as many citizens as you can before it's too late.

👍 Thumb up for more updates!🔥

Tags: Simulator, Fireman, Fireguard, Fire, City, RPG, Citizens, Training, Fun.
